title: manni lifecycle strict (1.0.0-proposal.1)
description: The strict overlay for manni:lifecycle:1.0.0-proposal.2. Stack it beside the open draft. It narrows the form of values the draft already claims and requires no key.

replaced-by.description: Strict holds the successor to one id, path or URL on one line with no surrounding space. A path may contain spaces.

supersedes.description: Strict holds each superseded page to one id, path or URL on one line with no surrounding space, in the string form and the list form alike.

remove-by.description: Strict holds the removal date to an RFC 3339 full date, `YYYY-MM-DD`. A year or month alone fails, and so does a timestamp.
